welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: up to $500 statement credit ("apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as $500") after you spend $5,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: Official Amex page 2026-10-19: "AS HIGH AS $500"; the amount shown can vary by applicant.

2026-11-13 as-high-as policy (lead decision): official Amex page (rendered GET 200, 9:35:44 PM PST): "APPLY AND FIND OUT YOUR WELCOME OFFER AS HIGH AS $500 Statement Credit after you spend $5,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." (Annual Fee: $0, unchanged). Variable amount, so not stored as a fixed bonus: bonus_points 500 -> 0 with bonus_value 'Varies', bonus_points_max 500, estimated_value 500 removed, offer_status -> as_high_as_ymmv, is_elevated -> false (no limited-time/increased-offer wording for this card; the 'Limited Time Offer' tag on the page belongs to the Marriott Bonvoy Business nav item). Spend/months unchanged.

caveats: Keep production card JSON untouched; this config is adaptor-only.
